text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the New Year's exchange event 
gathering local elementary school 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! What should I do so I can 
run like you older girls?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Daily discipline. Nothing surpasses 
that."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well. What I did was stuff like 
meditating under a waterfall and scaling a 
cliff within a time limit~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, things are bustling over there. As 
expected of a sparkly Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh wow, it really is! 'Sup, little lady.

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... I-I've been really captivated by 
the way you run, big sister...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, thanks! I'm honored to have a fan 
like you, young lady.

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You always refuse to give up until the 
very end... It-It's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I just kept losing race after race... 
Everyone else looked... so dazzling..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ... Yeah, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It just makes you feel hollow, you know? 
Like, what's the point of someone like me 
trying hard? So you put up walls and tell 
yourself doing "just enough" is fine.

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "...You know that, Sis...? Then why...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, little lady. Got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"The mock race will be starting shortly! 
Everyone participating in the New Year's 
exchange, please come and cheer them on!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... the girls in my group are all top 
contenders. But—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner into the final 
straight! Kitasan Black still holds the 
lead! Tokai Teio and the rest are in hot 
pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Slightly behind the front pack is Nice 
Nature! Desperately hanging on so she 
won't be left behind!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...! Big sis...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(No matter how big the gap is, I'll keep 
looking forward! I want to see it too!)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (The view from the top...!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She's closing in!! Nice Nature is closing 
in!! Catching up to the formidable 
contenders, she surges toward the goal!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...And 3rd place again?! Tahaha, well 
that's pretty anticlimactic..."

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... That's not true at all! You were 
amazing, Sis!! No matter how far ahead 
they were, you kept biting back at 
them......!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you never give up was so cool...! 
I... I want to, too...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. It's not something 
that disappears easily, after all."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That desire to "win"...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"It's just so easy, you know~? Giving up 
on your dreams. 'Cause that way, you don't 
get hurt."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, pretending to be satisfied is way 
more exhausting. Thanks to all sorts of 
people, I finally realized that.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Why not keep at it a little longer, little 
lady? If you do, someday—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I think someone who calls you 'cool'... 
will definitely find you someday and cheer 
you on."

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! I want to! I want to become an 
Umamusume just like you, Sis...!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...U-Um! I have a favor to ask...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look at this race. Her positioning in the 
final stretch is a textbook example, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, this is very educational...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nice Nature provided race 
commentary for the sake of the future 
athletes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is 100 pull-ups on the 
bar. I'll spot you if it gets tough~.

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes! Ooonnee, twooo...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nice Nature offered training 
guidance for the sake of the future 
athletes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's hear those voices! Tracén, 
fight ooon~~!

text_block_list.name: Shy Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fi... ght...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Nice Nature accompanied the 
future athletes on their running drills.
